result.one_liner: Email delivery and marketing platform with REST API for sending transactional emails, managing campaigns, and monitoring email statistics.

evidence.quote: Twilio SendGrid supports API keys delivered via Bearer token or Basic authentication
Bearer Token Authentication: API keys can be delivered via Bearer token, which is the recommended approach for the v3 Web API
The free tier includes 100 emails per day with no credit card required and no expiration date
Free tier of 100 emails per day includes basic API access, SMTP relay, and 1 sender identity
The SendGrid v3 Web API provides a REST interface to send email at scale
Sign up for SendGrid and start sending emails with the free tier - 100 emails per day, no credit card required

result.notes: SendGrid offers a permanently free tier (100 emails/day) with self-serve API key generation. The v3 REST API covers email sending, templates, campaigns, contacts, suppression, statistics, and webhooks. No official MCP server identified.
